items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams week-to-week with hamstring (MRI done), 'will likely miss some time'; same left hamstring as college injury. Tyson Bagent backup.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring pull while scrambling; walking postgame with slight limp.
items.implication: Miss at least some time; Bagent starts potentially vs PHI.
items.opportunity: Bears skill players (Odunze, Moore, Loveland, Swift) may see volume shifts under backup.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered another dislocated left elbow, X-rays negative for fracture, expected to miss time (previously ~1 month for same injury); ruled OUT, further testing Monday. Marcus Mariota in.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on freak play bracing fall; same as prior injury that cost ~month.
items.implication: Significant absence for WAS offense; stash/backup QB and elevated WR/TE usage.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catchers (McLaurin, etc.) see full opportunity.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket possible); prior GTD with optimism.
items.why: Optimism he can go despite cracked rib.
items.implication: Full or near-full role expected in LAC offense.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes yesterday; 36-12 opportunities through 2 weeks. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving emerging as clear lead back in TB.
items.opportunity: Dominant early-down + route work; start confidently.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson fumble (7th in 31 games) punished with playing time cut; NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense weapon needs + Brown absence.

items.text: Saquon Barkley stinger, MRI today, hope minor; played through it.
Raiders HC: Brock Bowers 'close, very close. He looks great' to return.
items.implication: Imminent TE1 return boosts LV passing.

items.text: RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); grab Jonah Coleman as beneficiary. Prior not expected.
items.implication: Opens DEN RB work for backups/Coleman.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for next man up.
Elevated routes/targets for other Ravens WRs.

items.text: Puka Nacua true GTD (hip); Levitan notes game-time.
items.implication: Monitor for MNF; if out, TE/WR2 bump.
items.opportunity: If OUT, routes to other LAR pass-catchers.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: 27%/38% target shares first two games, leads all WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target volume in PHI.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. down to 0.53 YPRR this season; among worst WRs (only a few worse).
items.why: Extremely low yards per route run data.
items.implication: Efficiency concerns despite volume; monitor role.

items.text: Mike Evans hip injury not serious per Shanahan; could have returned Q4 if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle.
Chris Olave (hamstring) clean/expected to play no docks; Joe Burrow (back) expected. Pittman OUT -> Bernard look; Harvey -> Coleman.
items.implication: Full roles for Olave/Burrow; Pittman absence elevates others.
items.opportunity: Olave routes/targets secure; IND WR2 bump.
